Third-party components shipped with sr2port and its launcher

sr2port.exe (the game) and Street Rod 2.exe (the launcher) are MIT licensed, see ../LICENSE.
Their source: https://github.com/kylofon/street-rod-2-sdl3

sr2port.exe contains the Nuked-OPL3 emulator (the AdLib chip), LGPL 2.1 or later, see
Nuked-OPL3-LICENSE.txt. Source: https://github.com/nukeykt/Nuked-OPL3 (opl3.c, opl3.h, unmodified).

All DLLs below are unmodified builds from MSYS2 (https://packages.msys2.org, mingw64 repository);
their sources are available from the MSYS2 package pages and the upstream projects named here. You
may replace any of them with your own build.

---- Used by sr2port.exe (the game)

SDL3.dll        SDL 3.4.16 (mingw-w64-x86_64-sdl3 3.4.16-1)
                zlib license, see SDL3-LICENSE.txt. https://libsdl.org

libiconv-2.dll  GNU libiconv 1.19 (mingw-w64-x86_64-libiconv 1.19-1), needed by SDL3.dll
                GNU LGPL 2.1 or later, see libiconv-COPYING.LIB.txt.
                Source: https://ftp.gnu.org/pub/gnu/libiconv/libiconv-1.19.tar.gz

---- Used by Street Rod 2.exe (the launcher)

wxbase32u_gcc_custom.dll, wxmsw32u_core_gcc_custom.dll
                wxWidgets 3.2.11 (mingw-w64-x86_64-wxwidgets3.2-common-libs / -msw-libs 3.2.11-1)
                wxWindows Library Licence 3.1, see wxWidgets-licence.txt. https://www.wxwidgets.org

libstdc++-6.dll, libgcc_s_seh-1.dll
                GCC 16.2.0 runtime libraries (mingw-w64-x86_64-gcc-libs 16.2.0-3), needed by wxWidgets
                GNU GPL 3 with the GCC Runtime Library Exception, see gcc-libs-COPYING3.txt and
                gcc-libs-COPYING.RUNTIME.txt. https://gcc.gnu.org

libwinpthread-1.dll
                mingw-w64 winpthreads (mingw-w64-x86_64-libwinpthread 14.0.0), see libwinpthread-COPYING.txt

The image libraries below are loaded by wxWidgets (libtiff by the wxWidgets core DLL, the rest by
libtiff or wxWidgets); the launcher shows no images from them.

libpng16-16.dll   libpng 1.6.58 (mingw-w64-x86_64-libpng), libpng license, see libpng-LICENSE.txt
libjpeg-8.dll     libjpeg-turbo 3.2.0 (mingw-w64-x86_64-libjpeg-turbo), IJG / BSD, see libjpeg-turbo-LICENSE.md
libtiff-6.dll     libtiff 4.7.2 (mingw-w64-x86_64-libtiff), libtiff license, see libtiff-LICENSE.md
libwebp-7.dll, libsharpyuv-0.dll
                  libwebp 1.6.0 (mingw-w64-x86_64-libwebp), BSD, see libwebp-COPYING.txt
libLerc.dll       LERC 4.1.1 (mingw-w64-x86_64-lerc), Apache 2.0, see lerc-LICENSE.txt
libdeflate.dll    libdeflate 1.26 (mingw-w64-x86_64-libdeflate), MIT, see libdeflate-COPYING.txt
libzstd.dll       Zstandard 1.5.7 (mingw-w64-x86_64-zstd), BSD, see zstd-LICENSE.txt
liblzma-5.dll     XZ Utils 5.8.4 (mingw-w64-x86_64-xz), 0BSD, see xz-COPYING.txt and xz-COPYING.0BSD.txt
zlib1.dll         zlib 1.3.2 (mingw-w64-x86_64-zlib), zlib license, see zlib-LICENSE.txt
libpcre2-16-0.dll PCRE2 10.48 (mingw-w64-x86_64-pcre2), BSD, see pcre2-LICENCE.md
libjbig-0.dll     JBIG-KIT 2.1 (mingw-w64-x86_64-jbigkit 2.1-6), GNU GPL 2 or later, see jbigkit-COPYING.txt.
                  Unmodified. Source: https://www.cl.cam.ac.uk/~mgk25/jbigkit/download/jbigkit-2.1.tar.gz
                  and the MSYS2 package's source (https://packages.msys2.org/base/mingw-w64-jbigkit).

Street Rod 2 is (c) California Dreams / Logical Design Works. None of its files are included.
